## Body

The installedVersion helper in harness/scripts/copilot-cli.mjs has a cheap offline proof seam: set COPILOT_BIN to an owned fake executable which requires COPILOT_AUTO_UPDATE=false and COPILOT_OFFLINE=true, then run the helper with inherited COPILOT_AUTO_UPDATE=true. Removing the helper override makes the fake exit 42; restoring it passes. This proves the env handoff without invoking the installed CLI, package cache, live daemon or a model. It does not prove internal /restart environment inheritance, which current CLI docs do not specify. PR325 at 9a77968 used this alongside independently killed no-alarm/no-cooldown/no-spawn-env mutants and a restored 11-daemon/22-spawn baseline. Its process-local window/cooldown and no-retrofit limits are explicit notes; the compaction continuation is complete. MagicWand: retain this fake-executable fixture as the version-reader contract test rather than requiring a live update canary.
